security_audit.summary: Manual review found no prompt injection or evidence of credential exfiltration. Most static findings are documentation links, local setup guidance, or guarded memory-tool validation. The pipe-to-shell installer command is a real critical risk, and the memory helper includes destructive directory deletion inside its configured storage root.

remediation.issue: Remote installer script is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell instruction with package-manager installation, checksum verification, or a download-review-execute sequence.

remediation.issue: Memory helper can recursively delete directories and clear all stored memory.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, expose deletion only to trusted callers, and document that clear_all_memory is for tests only.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md begins with text before the YAML frontmatter.
remediation.suggestion: Move the metadata frontmatter to the first line so marketplace tooling can parse the skill cleanly.

content.user_title: Build Claude API Apps with Cookbooks
content.value_statement: Developers need reliable examples for Claude API features and integration patterns. This skill organizes cookbook guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains basic Claude API message calls and model usage patterns.
Summarizes tool use and function calling examples for application workflows.
Guides multimodal tasks such as image analysis, OCR, and chart interpretation.
Indexes cookbook topics for RAG, summarization, classification, and text-to-SQL.
Describes third-party integration examples for vector search, embeddings, and web content.
Provides a local memory tool example with path validation and scoped file operations.
limitations: It provides reference guidance and examples, not a complete application framework.
Some examples require valid Claude API credentials and external service accounts.
Model names and provider APIs may change after the skill content was processed.
The bundled memory script must be reviewed before production use.

use_cases.title: Prototype Claude API Features
use_cases.description: Find relevant cookbook patterns for messages, tool use, multimodal input, and prompt caching before building a prototype.

use_cases.title: Plan AI Assistant Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare RAG, tool calling, sub-agent, and evaluation patterns for a production assistant design.

use_cases.title: Teach Claude Integration Concepts
use_cases.description: Use the organized references to explain API setup, cookbook categories, and practical implementation choices.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Starting Example
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a relevant cookbook topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find the best Claude cookbook example for [task]. Explain which reference file to start with and why.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Tool Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a Claude tool use workflow for [business process]. Include tool responsibilities, validation points, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Compare RAG Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare cookbook patterns for a RAG system over [content type]. Cover indexing, retrieval, reranking, and evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Claude App Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Claude application plan: [plan]. Identify matching cookbook patterns, missing safeguards, and implementation risks.

output_examples.input: Find cookbook guidance for building a customer support assistant with tools.
output_examples.output: A short recommendation pointing to tool use references, customer service agent concepts, validation checkpoints, and follow-up implementation tasks.

output_examples.input: Help me choose a RAG pattern for internal documentation search.
output_examples.output: A comparison of RAG cookbook topics, including document chunking, contextual embeddings, semantic search, reranking, and evaluation planning.

output_examples.input: Review my plan for image analysis with Claude.
output_examples.output: A structured review of multimodal cookbook guidance, image quality requirements, prompt clarity, supported formats, and expected limitations.

best_practices: Start with the reference index, then open the topic file that matches the feature you are building.
Treat cookbook snippets as examples and adapt authentication, retries, logging, and validation for your environment.
Check current Claude API documentation before using model names, limits, or provider-specific settings.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into source code or chat prompts when adapting examples.
Do not expose file deletion or memory clearing helpers to untrusted callers.
Do not run remote installer commands without reviewing the downloaded script and source.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps users navigate Claude cookbook examples for API usage, tool calling, multimodal tasks, RAG, and agent workflows.

faq.question: Does it execute the cookbook examples automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and reference material. Users must run any code in their own development environment.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for planning and implementation assistance.

faq.question: Does it include real API credentials?
faq.answer: No. It references environment variables for credentials and does not include hardcoded Claude API keys.

faq.question: What should I review before production use?
faq.answer: Review authentication, rate limits, error handling, model names, external service dependencies, and the local memory script.

faq.question: Why does the audit mention installer risk?
faq.answer: One reference suggests piping a remote installer script to a shell. Review or replace that installation method before use.
